name: prostgles
description: Prostgles UI runtime and configurable PostgreSQL dashboard

scripts.build: npm ci && npm run compile && npm prune --omit=dev
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV='production' node dist/server/src/index.js
scripts.dev: npm ci && cross-env NODE_ENV='development' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4048' concurrently --kill-others "tsc -w" "tsc-alias -w" "node --watch --watch-path=dist --trace-warnings --inspect dist/server/src/index.js"
scripts.dev:electron: npm ci && cross-env NODE_ENV='development' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4048' concurrently --kill-others "tsc -w" "tsc-alias -w" "node --watch --watch-path=dist --trace-warnings --inspect dist/server/src/testElectron.js"
scripts.package:prepare: npm --prefix ../client ci && npm --prefix ../client run build && npm ci && npm run compile && node ./scripts/preparePackage.mjs

author: Prostgles LTD <office@prostgles.com>
